param: Λ₁ Recruitment rate into susceptible humans (proportion at which susceptible people are recruited)
Λ₂ Recruitment rate into infectious humans (proportion at which infected people are recruited)
β₁ Effective contact rate with infectious humans (human-to-human transmission)
β₂ Effective contact rate with Ebola pathogens in the environment (environment-to-human transmission)
β₃ Effective contact rate with deceased humans (funeral/burial transmission)
μ Natural death rate of humans
δ₁ Disease-induced death rate for infectious humans
δ₂ Shedding rate of infectious humans into the environment
δ₃ Quarantine rate of infectious humans
γ₁ Recovery rate of quarantined humans
γ₂ Disease-induced death rate for quarantined humans
η Proportion (or rate factor) of shedding from deceased humans into the environment
ρ Burial rate of deceased humans (removal of corpses)
φ Clearance/decay rate of Ebola pathogens in the environment
λ Force of infection on susceptibles from infectious humans, environment, and deceased
δ₂I Pathogen input from infectious shedding
ηD Pathogen input from deceased shedding
